name: FishingFloat
concept: A classic red-and-white round angler's float on a thin quill, the kind an Everon angler clips on the line. It is the prop at the cast point; it dips when a fish bites.
prompt: Modelled in Blender by model.py: a small red and white round bobber with a thin quill above and a short stem below. no text, no logos.
